blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the differential \(dy\) in the following cases: \(y = x^{3} - 3\sqrt{x}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh differential ka seedha sawal hai.
Differential ka matlab: derivative ko \(dx\) se multiply karna, \(dy = f'(x)\,dx\).
Diya kya hai? \(y = x^{3} - 3\sqrt{x}\). Find kya karna hai? \(dy\).
Plan: \(\sqrt{x}\) ko \(x^{1/2}\) likhna, har term ka derivative, aur aakhir mein \(dx\) lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = x^{3} - 3\sqrt{x}\).
Maloom karna: \(dy\).
Tareeqa: \(dy = \frac{dy}{dx}\,dx\).

Root ko power ki shakal mein likhein
\[y = x^{3} - 3x^{1/2}\]
Kyun: is tarah power rule seedha lag jata hai; square root ki power \(\frac{1}{2}\) hoti hai.

Differentiate karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 3x^{2} - 3 \cdot \tfrac{1}{2}x^{-1/2}\]
\[= 3x^{2} - \dfrac{3}{2\sqrt{x}}\]
Kyun: har term par power rule. \(x^{1/2}\) ka derivative \(\frac{1}{2}x^{-1/2}\) hai, aur negative power ka matlab neeche (denominator mein) jana, yani \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\).

\(dx\) lagayein
\[dy = \left(3x^{2} - \dfrac{3}{2\sqrt{x}}\right)dx\]
Kyun: differential ki definition. Poore derivative ko bracket mein rakh kar \(dx\) se multiply kiya.
Dhyan dein: bracket ke baghair sirf aakhri term ke saath \(dx\) likhna ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the differential \(dy\) in the following cases: \(y = \cos x^{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan pehle notation samajhna zaroori hai: \(\cos x^{2}\) ka matlab \(\cos(x^{2})\) hai, yani cosine ke andar \(x^{2}\).
Function ke andar function hai, is liye chain rule lagega.
Find kya karna hai? \(dy\).
Plan: chain rule se derivative, phir \(dx\) lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = \cos x^{2} = \cos(x^{2})\).
Maloom karna: \(dy\).
Tareeqa: chain rule, phir \(dy = \frac{dy}{dx}\,dx\).

Differentiate karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\sin(x^{2}) \cdot \dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{2})\]
\[= -\sin(x^{2}) \cdot 2x\]
\[= -2x\sin x^{2}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{d}{dx}\cos u = -\sin u\,\frac{du}{dx}\), jahan \(u = x^{2}\). Pehle bahar ka derivative (\(\cos\) se \(-\sin\)), andar wala \(x^{2}\) waisa hi, phir andar ka derivative \(2x\) multiply.

\(dx\) lagayein
\[dy = -2x\sin x^{2}\,dx\]
Kyun: differential ki definition.

Note
\(\cos x^{2}\) aur \(\cos^{2} x = (\cos x)^{2}\) alag cheezein hain. \(\cos^{2} x\) ka jawab \(dy = -2\sin x\cos x\,dx\) hota, jo bilkul mukhtalif hai. Sawal ko ghaur se parhiye ke square kis par hai.
